$description: MetalUI components. Each has a React export, a SwiftUI symbol, a shadcn registry item and an agent guide.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: A press-in pill button. It sinks 1px into a well while held and springs back on release. It comes with standard, primary and destructive caps.

components.name: cue
components.title: Cue family
components.description: Recognition made visible on the text: date, duration, amount, measurement, tag, derived tag and hex cues that never move a letter; the URL host pill and the inferred pill; the dimple, ghost dimple and urgency LED in the margin; the trailing life glyph.

react.export: Cue, CueUrl, CueInferred, CueUrgency, CueLife, Dimple

swift.symbol: MetalDimple, MetalCueURLPill, MetalCueInferred, MetalCueUrgency, MetalCueLife, Text.metalCue(_:)

components.name: hover-engraving
components.title: Hover engraving
components.description: A block's identity on a 420 ms dwell: a frosted pill beside its first line, engraved in the label role: kind, time, edits, other events, derived tags and the recognizer's status with an LED.

react.base: none (a note on its block; the block points aria-describedby at it)

components.name: kbd
components.title: Keycap
components.description: A key's glyph on a small raised cap, in the readout role: 20 tall (16 in a footer), on a light surface, a graphite strip, or sunk into a toast's Undo.

components.name: lens-bar
components.title: Lens bar
components.description: A floating frosted pill that names a lens's question, counts its matches, says where the answer came from and switches views with a compact segmented control; pin keeps it as a live region, close ends it.

components.name: memory-scrubber
components.title: Memory scrubber
components.description: Time as a dimension of the surface: a well track with an intent fill, tick marks for blocks and edits, day labels and a knurled knob on Base UI Slider, with a MEMORY readout and NOW.

components.name: past-banner
components.title: Past banner
components.description: The only chrome that changes while the canvas is scrubbed into the past: a graphite pill with the MEMORY engraving, the moment viewed, and Back to Now.

components.name: provenance-tooltip
components.title: Provenance tooltip
components.description: One hover away from every cue: a graphite tooltip on Base UI Tooltip that says where the cue came from (RULE · DATE PARSER, JEV · 0.82, YOU), with the number whenever the app guessed.

components.name: region
components.title: Region
components.description: A drawn rectangle with a name that carries a rule: a sunk well with a head (name, rule, count), a drop-target state, dim and past states, renaming, and a pinned-lens form as a frosted plate with rows.

react.base: none (a group; its rows and dimples are real controls)

components.name: segmented
components.title: Segmented control
components.description: A pill of pills on Base UI RadioGroup: a well track, segments on the height ladder, and a raised thumb that glides to the selection on the part spring.

components.name: selection-frame
components.title: Selection frame
components.description: KAMUI-14, the one selection for every kind of object: a 1.25 green ring with a flat collar at offset 6, eight handles on the ring line, and a graphite readout of the measured frame. Hover shows only faint corner dots and an edge light.

react.base: none (an object; the host carries aria-selected)

components.name: size-readout
components.title: Size readout
components.description: A graphite pill that reads a measured value: an object's size, a multi-selection's count, a copy, a zoom level. The KAMUI-14 readout on its own.

react.base: none (a readout; aria-hidden where it repeats what the object states)

components.name: status
components.title: LED and status badge
components.description: A 4–5 pt LED lit from the top left (green live, amber waiting, red failed, blue link, off), and the 24 tall status badge: an LED and the state in the label role, not pressable, with the fixing command as a tooltip.

components.name: suggestion-chip
components.title: Suggestion chip
components.description: One question the recognizer asks at middle confidence, beside its block: the label, the confidence, and accept and dismiss buttons. Faint until the block is hovered.

components.name: tool-strip
components.title: Tool strip
components.description: A graphite toolbar of verbs over a click selection: Tasks, Summarise, Gather, Region, Export, and Send away after an engraved separator. Rises 4 on the part spring.
